results.title: 1970 Dodge Charger R/T 440 Six Pack
results.description: This 1970 Dodge Charger R/T is one of 337 examples that were built for the model year with a 440ci V8 topped by a trio of Holley two-barrel carburetors and linked with a three-speed automatic transmission. The car underwent a rotisserie refurbished around 2016 and is finished in Plum Crazy over white vinyl upholstery. Equipment includes a Sure Grip differential, body-color 15" steel wheels, hubcaps, hideaway headlamps, hood graphics, tail stripes, woodgrain interior trim, a center console, and courtesy lighting. Power steering and front disc brakes have been added. The seller purchased the vehicle in 2023, and the interior was reupholstered in 2025. This Charger 440 Six Pack is now offered with a broadcast sheet, refurbishment photos, removed black seat covers, a set of spare Magnum 500–style wheels, and transferable New York registration in the seller's name.

results.title: IDF searching Kibbutz Zikim following breach discovered in perimeter fence
results.description:
IDF troops are searching Kibbutz Zikim in the Gaza border area after a breach was discovered in the community's perimeter fence. According to security sources, there is no indication of an infiltration from the Gaza Strip at this stage.

The IDF Spokesperson's Unit stated, "A short time ago, forces were summoned to Kibbutz Zikim following a report from the community’s security coordinator regarding a cut discovered in the fence. Upon arrival, troops initiated a sweep of the area. As of now, no suspects have been identified, and it cannot be determined when the breach was made. IDF forces are continuing their search to rule out any security incidents."

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)
